headline: War Day 517: Six Fronts Intensify, Casualties Surge
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the war still turns on a handful of corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, recording 56 ownership changes in the past day; the latest hour shows Colonial and Warden losses climbing past 1,000 per hour each, with both two‑hour trends accelerating sharply. Callahans Passage continues to bleed — 948 Colonial and 1,212 Warden casualties in the last two hours — and its one‑hour rates have surged to 523 and 580 respectively, both accelerating. Palantine Berm has intensified, posting 283 Colonial and 237 Warden losses in two hours; one‑hour rates now exceed 179 and 171 per hour, also accelerating. Stlican Shelf shows a mixed picture: Colonial losses have cooled to 43 per hour while Warden losses rise to 72, though the two‑hour trend still climbs for both sides. Nevish Line’s Colonial rate has jumped to 85 per hour (accelerating) while Warden losses ease to 129 (steady). Stonecradle’s casualties have fallen to single digits per hour, yet the two‑hour trend shows a modest rise for both factions. Enlistment activity mirrors the fighting, climbing on the most active fronts and remaining flat elsewhere. New low‑level skirmishes appear in Callums Cape, Kuura Strand, Mooring County and Oarbreaker, but none have generated significant base turnover.
